P.text: Vault balance exceeds the target; any address can call rebalanceFunds() on FastAccessVault, which is external and lacks any role or ownership check despite the interface documenting it as owner-only.
P.evidence_quote: `rebalanceFunds()` in `FastAccessVault` is declared `external` and lacks any role or ownership check, despite the interface documenting it as owner-only.

I.text: rebalanceFunds() should be restricted to the owner/authorized role and/or rate-limited so that only authorized callers can move excess buffer to the custodian.
I.evidence_quote: despite the interface documenting it as owner-only

V.text: Any account can invoke rebalanceFunds() repeatedly whenever the buffer is above target, transferring the full excess to the custodian, stripping on-chain buffer down to target, degrading instant redemption availability, and potentially misdirecting funds if the custodian address is stale or compromised.
V.evidence_quote: any account can invoke it repeatedly whenever the buffer is above target, forcing excess liquidity off-chain and reducing instant redemption capacity
